historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and disapproved the demolition.
A two-story single-family home stood at the property.

The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and disapproved the new construction, but required a notice of special restrictions restricting the building to three units, with stairs visually open or the ground level and bathroom reduced to a half bath.
